name: Engagement
overview: Scripture portrays engagement and the relationship before marriage as a sacred and purposeful period grounded in God's design and blessing. The Lord honors the union between a man and a woman, promising favor to those who find a wife (Proverbs 18:22) and recognizing a prudent wife as a gift from Him (Proverbs 19:14). The commitment is likened to a betrothal marked by righteousness, lovingkindness, and mercy (Hosea 2:19), emphasizing the seriousness and divine intention behind this covenant. Moreover, the newly married couple is called to cherish and support one another, as seen in the command for the husband to care for his wife during their first year together (Deuteronomy 24:5), highlighting the importance of nurturing the relationship before entering into the full responsibilities of life together.
